description: D9-5 frozen per-family fitting configuration. Every setting a model family needs is declared here explicitly, never as a code literal; changing any value here is a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze, not a silent runtime choice.

gmm.effective_component_weight_threshold_not: a component with fitted mixture weight below this is reported as unoccupied; diagnostic only, never used to change n_components or covariance_type.
gmm.fitting_policy_note: n=~5.5M rows x d=5 x float64 fits host RAM comfortably per the D9-5 RAM preflight (see data_scope/data_scope_audit.md); no chunked/streaming EM implemented for D9-5.

nf_ac.scout_selection_rule: argmin(best_validation_metric) over status==completed rows matching this track_id
nf_ac.config_label_note: the scout used a single seed (20260720) and 10 epochs; it selected architecture capacity only, never a final champion. D9-5 trains new NF_AC runs from initialization for every seed and never reuses a scout checkpoint.

execution_policy.justification: Bounds per mission Sec 11.1 (minimum_epochs>=20, maximum_epochs<=200, patience in [20,30]). The scout's best_validation_epoch was still 8-10 out of a 10-epoch budget on a single shard (~501k rows), i.e. not clearly plateaued; D9-5 trains on the full ~5.5M-row per-track scope (~11x more rows/epoch), so 20 minimum epochs gives comparable total gradient-update exposure to a much longer single-shard run. maximum_epochs=100 and patience=25 (mid of the allowed range) bound worst-case wall time to a scientifically defensible level without claiming the ceiling guarantees convergence -- see Sec 11.1 constraint against that claim. Frozen before the first seed of either track was trained; not revised after observing any seed's curve.

nf_ac.optimizer_settings_note: carried over from configs/afterms/d9_training_v0.json's per-candidate defaults for continuity with the D9/D9B baseline; not re-tuned for D9-5.
